item.title: SA: Black Motion rework Lisa Ramey’s Better Than That
item.description: South African producer duo Black Motio has released an Afro-house remix of New York-based R&B singer Lisa Ramey’s track ‘Better Than That’, through Lisa Ramey Music. The remix, which is available for streaming and download on major digital platforms, features a percussion-driven reworking of the original song, which appeared on Ramey’s 2024 EP Foretaste. item.title: Ngeke Festival launches at Constitutional Hill with music-led call for accountability
item.description: By Siphokazi Ndlovu and Goitsemang Kemp On 6 December 2025, Constitutional Hill in Braamfontein hosted the inaugural Ngeke Festival, an event that positioned music and performance as tools for addressing corruption and its effects on young people and marginalised communities in South Africa. The historic site, long associated with justice and civic rights, provided the backdrop for a programme that combined activism with artistic expression. item.title: Big Zulu appointed as brand ambassador for SA’s passenger rail network
item.description: The Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) has announced the appointment of hip hop artist Big Zulu as its official brand ambassador in a bid to reinforce public trust and promote rail travel across the nation. Big Zulu, known for his storytelling and connection to everyday South Africans, will lend his profile to PRASA campaigns and commuter outreach efforts. item.title: Internship opportunities in media and creative fields at the MIAF
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) invites young, passionate and unemployed individuals to apply for internship opportunities offered through the Foundation’s Internship Programme, aimed at providing valuable work experience. item.title: SA: Relebogile Mabotja wins Best Talk Show at Telkom Radio Awards
item.description: South African broadcaster Relebogile Mabotja has won the Best Talk Show award in the Commercial category at the Telkom Radio Awards, an accolade presented over the weekend. Mabotja, whose career spans more than two decades across radio, television, music and production, has established herself as a prominent voice in the country’s media sector. item.title: Liberia Music Awards 2025: All the winners
item.description: The Liberia Music Awards (LMA) has announced the winners of its 2025 edition, with King Dennis earning the Artist of the Year title. The ceremony, now in its 12th year, was held under the theme Loud and Liberian and highlighted key contributors to the country’s music output over the past year. King Dennis led the night with two major wins, securing both Artist of the Year and Male Artist of the Year. His victories mark a return to prominence following a period of rebuilding in his career. item.title: SA: CottonFest shuts down amid shareholder disputes
item.description: CottonFest, one of South Africa’s prominent youth-centred cultural festivals, has officially announced its closure following internal disputes among its shareholders. The decision brings an end to the event founded by the late artist Riky Rick more than seven years ago. item.title: Milk + Cookies confirms final line-up for 2026 SA edition
item.description: Milk + Cookies has announced the final line-up for its 2026 South Africa edition, confirming the addition of UK-based artists Odeal and Elmiene to the festival programme. Odeal will perform on the main stage in Cape Town, while Elmiene is set to make his Johannesburg debut. The pair join a roster headlined by US rapper Gunna, with Canadian duo Majid Jordan scheduled to appear in both Cape Town and Johannesburg. item.title: Nigeria and SA rap duo unveil collaborative EP Sabali
item.description: Nigerian artist Son of Ladun and South African musician Priddy Prince have released their joint EP titled Sabali. The project, which is available for streaming and download across major digital platforms, is an introspective project shaped by patience, resilience and artistic growth. The record arrives with two new music videos, ‘Feel Me’ and ‘I Learned’, which expand the EP’s themes through cinematic storytelling. item.title: SA: Mörda added to Makhelwane Festival line-up
item.description: Soweto is gearing up for a weekend of music, culture, and creativity as the Makhelwane Festival returns for its eleventh edition in Johannesburg, South Africa, on 12 December. Multi-award-winning South African DJ and music producer Mörda joins the line-up, bringing high-energy DJ sets and genre-blending beats to Poka Street and Thesis Concept Store.
